recipes.title: Warm Spiced Butternut Squash, Banana & Cinnamon Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Velvety autumn-gold rolled oats simmered in oat milk with mashed roasted butternut squash, ripe banana, warm cinnamon, ginger, clove, sliced almonds, and walnut oil.
steps: Whisk cooked mashed butternut squash, mashed banana, oat milk, cinnamon, grated ginger, and clove smoothly in a saucepan.
Stir in rolled oats and simmer gently over medium-low heat 7 to 8 minutes until deeply golden and plush.
Spoon into warm bowls and top with banana slices, sliced almonds, and fragrant roasted walnut oil.
tips: Buy pre-cubed fresh or frozen butternut squash and steam a big batch once a week so weekday breakfasts take under 10 minutes with zero peeling.
Pureed squash gives morning oats a velvety pie-filling texture that swallows effortlessly.

recipes.title: Savory Pan-Steamed Butternut Squash, Crispy Sage & Soft Egg Hash
recipes.summary: Comforting skillet hash pan-steaming small-diced pre-cubed butternut squash and celery with olive oil, fresh sage, thyme, rosemary, black pepper, and lid-steamed eggs.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet, add small-diced squash, finely diced celery, sage, thyme, rosemary, black pepper, and 3 tablespoons water.
Cover tightly and steam-saute 9 to 10 minutes until squash is completely fork-tender and lightly caramelized at the edges.
Nestle two cracked eggs directly into shallow wells in the hash, cover again, and cook gently 4 minutes until whites set and yolks stay golden and soft.
tips: Steaming pre-cubed squash with a splash of water under a lid guarantees soft tender cubes without wrist-heavy stirring.
Frozen cubed butternut squash works straight from the bag—no thawing needed.

recipes.title: Velvety Butternut Squash, Date & Dark Chocolate Buckwheat Porridge
recipes.summary: Cozy gluten-free porridge warming cooked buckwheat groats and mashed butternut squash in oat milk with chopped Medjool dates, cinnamon, melted dark chocolate, cashew butter, and almond oil.
steps: Simmer cooked buckwheat groats, mashed butternut squash, oat milk, finely chopped dates, and cinnamon 8 to 10 minutes until lush and golden.
Remove from heat and swirl in smooth cashew butter and shaved dark chocolate until silky marbled ribbons form.
Spoon into warm bowls and finish with sweet culinary almond oil.
tips: Sweet squash and nutty buckwheat complement bittersweet dark chocolate like an indulgent warm custard.
Keep cooked squash puree in an ice-cube tray in the freezer so you can drop 3 cubes straight into morning porridge.

recipes.title: Overnight Autumn Butternut Squash, Diced Apple & Chia Oats
recipes.summary: Make-ahead chilled breakfast jars whisking smooth cooked butternut squash, oat milk, rolled oats, chia seeds, warm cinnamon, ginger, sweet diced apple, almonds, and flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: cooked mashed or pureed butternut squash

steps: Whisk smooth butternut squash, oat milk, chia seeds, cinnamon, and ground ginger in a bowl until silky and golden.
Fold in rolled oats and peeled finely diced apple, divide into two jars, and refrigerate overnight.
Top in the morning with sliced almonds and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
tips: Prepping jars the night before gives you an effortless chilled autumn breakfast on busy mornings.
Peeling and dicing the apple very small lets it soften gently overnight.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric Butternut Squash, Spinach & Chickpea Morning Skillet
recipes.summary: Plant-based warm breakfast cooking small-diced pre-cubed squash and lightly smashed chickpeas in olive oil with golden turmeric, cumin, coriander seed, black pepper, and wilted spinach.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet, stir in turmeric, cumin, coriander seed, black pepper, small-diced squash, and 3 tablespoons water.
Cover and steam-saute 9 minutes until squash pierces easily with a fork.
Fold in lightly smashed chickpeas and baby spinach 2 to 3 minutes until greens wilt softly and spices coat every bite.
tips: Lightly mashing chickpeas with a fork prevents them from rolling on the plate and makes a cozy soft scramble.
Top with a squeeze of fresh orange or a spoonful of chopped cilantro.

recipes.title: Silky Butternut Squash, Banana & Blueberry Almond Oil Oat Pancakes
recipes.summary: Tender golden griddle cakes blending cooked butternut squash, rolled oats, ripe banana, oat milk, cinnamon, ginger, and sweet almond oil, crowned with juicy blueberries.
steps: Blend rolled oats, cooked butternut squash, ripe banana, oat milk, half the almond oil, cinnamon, and ginger 45 seconds until thick and smooth.
Lightly brush a nonstick skillet with remaining almond oil over medium-low heat and spoon small 2-tablespoon silver-dollar pancakes.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until puffed and golden, then serve topped with juicy warm blueberries.
tips: Silver-dollar size makes flipping steady and clean without batter dripping.
Cooked squash and banana keep these whole-grain pancakes moist and soft even without eggs.

recipes.title: Warm Butternut Squash, Cranberry & Brazil Nut Pearl Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Comforting morning porridge simmering cooked pearl barley and mashed butternut squash in oat milk with chopped dates, tart cranberries, cinnamon, Brazil nuts, and walnut oil.
steps: Simmer cooked pearl barley, mashed butternut squash, oat milk, chopped dates, cranberries, and cinnamon 8 to 10 minutes until berries burst into ruby swirls.
Spoon the creamy golden porridge into warm bowls.
Finish with finely chopped Brazil nuts and a drizzle of roasted walnut oil.
tips: Pre-cooked pearl barley turns into rich morning porridge in under 10 minutes.
Sweet squash and dates naturally mellow bright tart cranberries.

recipes.title: Tender Butternut Squash, Baby Arugula & Rosemary Stovetop Frittata
recipes.summary: Fluffy covered-skillet frittata folding fork-tender cooked butternut cubes, wilted baby arugula, olive oil, finely minced rosemary, thyme, caraway, and soft eggs.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and toss cooked squash cubes with minced rosemary, thyme, crushed caraway, and baby arugula 2 minutes until greens wilt.
Pour whisked eggs seasoned with cracked black pepper evenly over the pan.
Cover tightly and cook over low heat 9 to 10 minutes until softly puffed and custardy throughout.
tips: Using leftover roasted dinner squash makes this golden frittata a 12-minute zero-chopping breakfast.
Lid-steaming eliminates lifting heavy skillets under a hot oven broiler.

recipes.title: Spiced Butternut Squash, Stewed Apricot & Cashew Quinoa Porridge
recipes.summary: Fragrant gluten-free breakfast warming cooked quinoa and silky butternut puree in oat milk with kitchen-snipped apricots, smooth cashew butter, cinnamon, ginger, and clove.
steps: Simmer cooked quinoa, mashed butternut squash, oat milk, snipped dried apricots, cinnamon, ginger, and clove 8 to 10 minutes until plush and fragrant.
Remove from heat and stir in smooth cashew butter until velvet-creamy.
Serve warm in cozy bowls.
tips: Snipping dried apricots directly over the pot with kitchen shears keeps sticky hands and cutting boards clean.
Quinoa adds gentle complete plant protein that keeps morning energy balanced.

recipes.title: Velvety Mashed Butternut, Soft Egg & Ruby Sumac Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Toasted whole-grain slices spread generously with warm olive-oil mashed butternut squash and thyme, topped with glossy scrambled egg, tangy sumac, nigella seed, and black pepper.
steps: Mash warm cooked butternut squash with half the olive oil, fresh thyme, and a pinch of cracked black pepper until spreadable.
Warm remaining olive oil in a skillet over low heat and fold beaten eggs gently 3 minutes until soft and glossy.
Spread velvety golden squash over warm toast, spoon soft eggs on top, and finish with tangy sumac and nigella seeds.
tips: Creamy mashed squash acts like rich golden butter while keeping whole-grain toast moist and gentle to bite.
Sumac brings a bright citrus sparkle that lifts sweet winter squash.

recipes.title: Velvety Butternut Squash, Sweet Apple & Crispy Sage Harvest Bisque
recipes.summary: Silky restaurant-style autumn soup simmering pre-cubed butternut squash and peeled sweet apple in vegetable broth with olive oil, sage, thyme, black pepper, and pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Warm olive oil in a soup pot and gently sizzle sliced sage, thyme, pre-cubed squash, diced peeled apple, and cracked black pepper 4 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, cover, and simmer 15 to 16 minutes until squash and apple collapse smoothly against a spoon.
Puree right inside the pot with an immersion blender until velvet-smooth, then ladle warm with swirls of emerald roasted pumpkin seed oil.
tips: Pre-cubed squash saves all heavy peeling and splitting while making this classic soup practically effortless.
An immersion blender keeps hot bisque safely in the pot without lifting heavy blender jars.

recipes.title: Warm Roasted Butternut Squash, Arugula & Cranberry Walnut Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Colorful autumn salad pairing fork-tender roasted pre-cubed squash with baby arugula, finely chopped cranberries, fresh thyme, toasted almonds, orange juice, and walnut oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F, toss pre-cubed squash with olive oil, thyme, and black pepper on parchment, and roast 18 to 20 minutes until fork-tender and golden.
Whisk roasted walnut oil, fresh orange juice, orange zest, and a pinch of black pepper.
Arrange baby arugula in bowls, spoon warm roasted squash on top, scatter finely chopped cranberries and sliced almonds, and drizzle evenly with citrus walnut oil.
tips: Chopping dried cranberries fine keeps them soft and evenly distributed without chewy tugs.
Roast an extra tray of squash cubes at the same time for tomorrow's breakfast or smoothie.

recipes.title: Golden Ginger, Turmeric & Coconut Milk Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.summary: Luminous warming bisque simmering pre-cubed squash in broth with freshly grated ginger, golden turmeric, cracked black pepper, olive oil, light coconut milk, and cilantro.

ingredient_details.item: pre-cubed fresh or frozen butternut squash

steps: Bloom freshly grated ginger, turmeric, and cracked black pepper in warm olive oil 45 seconds.
Add pre-cubed butternut squash and vegetable broth, cover, and simmer 15 to 16 minutes until completely soft.
Puree velvety smooth with an immersion blender, swirl in light coconut milk, and garnish bowls with fresh cilantro.
tips: Frozen pre-cubed squash works wonderfully here and needs zero defrosting or cutting.
Warm silky pureed soups are soothing, hydrating, and effortless on swallowing.

recipes.title: Spiced Butternut Squash, Chickpea & Coriander Cumin Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Fragrant midday grain bowl pan-steaming small-diced pre-cubed squash and tender chickpeas with olive oil, cumin, coriander seed, black pepper, warm brown rice, and cilantro.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet, bloom ground cumin, coriander seed, and cracked black pepper 30 seconds, then stir in small-diced squash and 1/3 cup water.
Cover and steam-saute 10 minutes until squash is fork-soft, then fold in rinsed chickpeas 3 minutes to warm through.
Spoon spiced squash and chickpeas over warm brown rice and finish with generous fresh cilantro.
tips: Pan-steaming small cubes takes half the time of oven roasting and keeps the squash tender and moist.
Squeeze a wedge of orange or lime on top for bright afternoon zing.

recipes.title: Tender Chicken, Butternut Squash, Celery & Rosemary Pearl Barley Soup
recipes.summary: Nourishing golden soup simmering pre-cubed butternut squash, thinly sliced celery stalk, succulent chicken breast pieces, cooked pearl barley, rosemary, bay leaf, and olive oil.
steps: Soften thinly sliced celery and bite-sized squash in olive oil with finely minced rosemary and black pepper 4 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and tuck in the bay leaf, simmering covered 10 minutes until squash is fork-tender.
Slip in small chicken pieces and cooked pearl barley, poaching gently 6 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through; discard bay leaf before serving.
tips: Soft sweet squash cubes give traditional chicken-barley soup natural golden richness.
Gentle poaching keeps lean chicken succulent and comfortable to chew.

recipes.title: Warm Butternut Squash, Flaked Salmon & Tarragon Arugula Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Omega-rich lunch bowl uniting tender steamed squash cubes, warm brown rice, flaky salmon, peppery baby arugula, bright orange zest, fresh tarragon, and olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Pan-steam small-diced squash in 1/4 cup water with half the olive oil covered 9 minutes until butter-soft.
Whisk remaining olive oil with fresh orange juice, zest, chopped tarragon, and cracked black pepper.
Layer warm brown rice and baby arugula into bowls, top with tender golden squash and flaked salmon, and spoon tarragon-orange oil across everything.
tips: Sweet autumn squash and bright herbal tarragon balance savory salmon cleanly.
Works beautifully with leftover roasted salmon or convenient pouched wild salmon.

recipes.title: Savory Butternut Squash, Mushroom & Sage Buckwheat Lunch Pilaf
recipes.summary: Earthy one-pan midday pilaf combining pan-steamed squash cubes, browned pre-sliced button mushrooms, warm cooked buckwheat groats, sage, thyme, caraway, and olive oil.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet, brown pre-sliced mushrooms 4 minutes, then add small-diced squash, sage, thyme, caraway, black pepper, and vegetable broth.
Cover and simmer gently 9 minutes until squash is fork-tender.
Fold in warm cooked buckwheat groats 2 minutes so the grains absorb the savory mushroom-sage broth.
tips: Pre-sliced mushrooms and pre-cubed squash let you build deep comforting flavor in one pan with minimal prep.
Keep a light splash of extra broth handy if you like pilafs extra moist.

recipes.title: Creamy Butternut Squash, Red Lentil & Fennel Seed Rosemary Soup
recipes.summary: Protein-rich velvety lunch soup simmering pre-cubed squash and quick-dissolving split red lentils in broth with olive oil, crushed fennel seed, rosemary, turmeric, and black pepper.
steps: Warm olive oil in a pot and soften pre-cubed squash with crushed fennel seed, minced rosemary, turmeric, and black pepper 3 minutes.
Add rinsed split red lentils and vegetable broth, cover partially, and simmer 16 minutes until lentils melt silky and squash turns butter-soft.
Puree briefly with an immersion blender for a thick, smooth golden bowl and finish with a thread of olive oil.
tips: Red lentils pack comforting plant protein and iron while thickening golden soup naturally without heavy cream.
Divides cleanly into 4 freezer-safe jars for effortless lunches all month.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Tender Butternut, Artichoke & Sweet Basil Chickpea Bowl
recipes.summary: Sunny coastal bowl pairing pan-steamed butternut cubes with jarred artichoke hearts, tender chickpeas, finely diced celery, fresh torn sweet basil, ruby sumac, and olive oil.
steps: Pan-steam small-diced squash and finely diced celery in 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1/3 cup water covered 9 minutes until fork-tender.
Fold in quartered artichoke hearts, rinsed chickpeas, tangy sumac, and cracked black pepper 2 minutes to warm through.
Spoon into bowls, drizzle with remaining extra-virgin olive oil, and fold in fresh torn sweet basil.
tips: Ruby sumac adds citrusy brightness that cuts through rich sweet squash without needing to juice lemons.
All components stay soft and easy to scoop cleanly with a fork.

recipes.title: Autumn Harvest Butternut Squash, Ruby Beetroot & Sage Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Jewel-toned lunch salad tossing tender sage-steamed squash, diced vacuum-packed beetroot, warm quinoa, baby arugula, toasted almonds, olive oil, and roasted walnut oil.
steps: Steam-saute small-diced squash in olive oil with sliced sage, cracked black pepper, and 1/4 cup water covered 9 minutes until tender.
Gently fold in diced cooked beetroot and warm quinoa 2 minutes until warmed through.
Arrange baby arugula in bowls, mound the golden-ruby quinoa mixture on top, and finish with roasted walnut oil and sliced almonds.
tips: Combining pre-cubed squash and pre-cooked beets gives rich roasted-root appeal in 20 minutes flat.
Every ingredient is naturally gluten-free and richly colorful.

recipes.title: One-Pan Sage-Roasted Butternut Squash, Broccoli & Rosemary Salmon
recipes.summary: Effortless sheet-pan dinner roasting pre-cubed butternut squash, tender broccoli florets, and flaky salmon fillets with olive oil, sage, rosemary, thyme, and fresh orange.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F and toss pre-cubed squash with half the olive oil, sliced sage, and black pepper on a parchment-lined pan; roast 12 minutes.
Add broccoli florets tossed in remaining olive oil, rosemary, and thyme alongside salmon fillets, spooning orange juice and zest over salmon and squash.
Roast 11 to 12 minutes more until salmon flakes easily and squash is deeply golden and butter-soft.
tips: Starting squash 12 minutes ahead guarantees velvety tenderness right as the salmon finishes.
One parchment sheet means almost zero post-dinner scrubbing.

recipes.title: One-Pot Braised Rosemary & Sage Chicken Thighs with Butternut & Carrots
recipes.summary: Succulent boneless chicken thigh pieces braised gently in broth with pre-cubed butternut squash, sweet carrot coins, fresh sage, rosemary, bay leaf, and olive oil.
equipment: Dutch oven or deep skillet with lid
steps: Warm olive oil in a deep skillet and lightly brown chicken thigh pieces 4 minutes with sliced sage, minced rosemary, and cracked black pepper.
Add pre-cubed squash, carrot coins, chicken broth, and bay leaf.
Cover tightly and braise gently 18 minutes until chicken is tender and squash softens into a silky golden herb gravy; discard bay leaf before serving.
tips: Some edges of the squash gently melt into the broth, naturally thickening it into a glossy spoonable sauce.
Boneless chicken thighs remain reliably soft and moist.

recipes.title: Cozy Lean Beef, Butternut Squash, Mushroom & Caraway Skillet Ragout
recipes.summary: Savory autumn skillet combining extra-lean ground beef, browned button mushrooms, pre-cubed butternut squash, celery, caraway, thyme, bay leaf, and beef broth.
steps: Warm olive oil in a deep skillet and cook extra-lean ground beef with pre-sliced mushrooms 6 minutes until browned and finely crumbled.
Stir in small-cubed squash, sliced celery, caraway, thyme, cracked black pepper, bay leaf, and beef broth.
Cover and simmer gently 15 minutes until squash is fork-soft and sauce turns rich and glossy; remove bay leaf and serve over brown rice or warm barley.
tips: Sweet golden squash creates a lovely sweet-savory balance with earthy mushrooms and caraway.
Ground beef cooks tender in minutes with zero tough knife work required at the table.

recipes.title: Velvety Butternut Squash, Chickpea & Curry Leaf Coconut Curry
recipes.summary: Fragrant golden curry simmering pre-cubed butternut squash and tender chickpeas in light coconut milk with turmeric, cumin, coriander seed, ginger, and curry leaves over brown rice.
steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and bloom grated ginger, curry leaves, turmeric, cumin, coriander seed, and black pepper 45 seconds.
Stir in pre-cubed squash, rinsed chickpeas, light coconut milk, and vegetable broth.
Cover and simmer gently 16 minutes until squash turns spoon-tender and creates a lush golden sauce; ladle generously over warm brown rice.
tips: Butternut squash naturally softens into velvety ribbons that thicken coconut curry with zero flour.
Leftovers taste even deeper the next evening.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Roasted Butternut Squash, Shaved Brussels Sprouts & Apple
recipes.summary: Caramelized autumn supper roasting pre-cubed squash, pre-shaved Brussels sprouts, and sweet apple slices with olive oil, sage, and thyme, finished with almonds and walnut oil.
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F and roast pre-cubed squash tossed with half the olive oil, thyme, and black pepper on parchment for 12 minutes.
Add pre-shaved Brussels sprouts, thin apple slices, sliced sage, and remaining olive oil, tossing gently.
Roast 12 minutes more until sprouts are caramelized and squash is butter-tender, finishing with roasted walnut oil and toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Both pre-cubed squash and pre-shaved Brussels sprouts cut prep down to minutes without straining hands.
Pair with cooked quinoa or warm lentils for a complete plant-based harvest supper.

recipes.title: Velvety Butternut Squash, Fresh Sage & Cashew Brown Rice Risotto
recipes.summary: Rich golden risotto-style bowl simmering cooked brown rice in vegetable broth with smooth mashed butternut squash, cashew butter, fragrant sage, thyme, olive oil, and baby arugula.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet with sliced sage, thyme, and cracked black pepper 1 minute until aromatic.
Stir in cooked brown rice, mashed butternut squash, and vegetable broth, simmering gently 8 to 10 minutes until deeply creamy.
Turn off heat, swirl in smooth cashew butter, and fold in baby arugula until softly wilted.
tips: Starting with pre-cooked brown rice and mashed squash delivers true Italian-style risotto creaminess in 14 minutes with zero constant standing.
Dairy-free yet astonishingly lush and easy to swallow.

recipes.title: Ginger-Sesame Glazed Butternut, Bell Pepper & Broccoli Buckwheat Bowl
recipes.summary: Vibrant weeknight skillet combining pan-steamed small-diced squash, tender broccoli florets, and sweet bell pepper with fresh ginger, rice bran oil, sesame oil, buckwheat, and cilantro.
steps: Warm rice bran oil in a skillet, add small-diced squash and 1/4 cup water, cover, and steam-saute 6 minutes until nearly tender.
Add broccoli florets, sliced bell pepper, grated ginger, and black pepper, cover, and steam 4 minutes more until everything is bright and fork-soft.
Fold in warm buckwheat groats off heat, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and shower with fresh cilantro.
tips: Giving small squash dice a 6-minute head start guarantees squash and crisp-tender broccoli finish together cleanly.
Sweet squash paired with nutty buckwheat and fragrant toasted sesame oil feels deeply satisfying.

recipes.title: Garlicky Steamed Clams in Saffron, Sweet Butternut & Fennel Broth
recipes.summary: Coastal Mediterranean supper steaming littleneck clams in luminous saffron broth enriched with tender small-diced butternut squash, celery, crushed fennel seed, thyme, and brown rice.

ingredient_details.note: scrubbed clean (or 6 oz canned whole baby clams)

steps: Steep saffron threads in 2 tablespoons warm water 5 minutes to bloom color and fragrance.

Soften tiny-diced squash and finely diced celery in olive oil with crushed fennel seed, thyme, and black pepper 4 minutes, then add broth and saffron water and simmer covered 6 minutes until squash is tender.
Add scrubbed clams, cover tightly, and steam 6 minutes until shells open (discard unopened shells); ladle clams and golden broth over warm brown rice.
tips: Sweet golden squash harmonizes beautifully with briny clams and floral saffron.
Swap in canned whole baby clams with their juice anytime you want zero scrubbing or heavy shell handling.

recipes.title: Moroccan Spiced Butternut Squash, Apricot & Chickpea Barley Tagine
recipes.summary: Warmly perfumed skillet supper simmering pre-cubed squash, tender chickpeas, and plump snipped apricots with cumin, coriander seed, ginger, cinnamon, olive oil, and cilantro over barley.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet and bloom grated ginger, cumin, coriander seed, and cinnamon 45 seconds.
Add pre-cubed squash, rinsed chickpeas, halved dried apricots, and vegetable broth.
Cover and simmer gently 16 to 18 minutes until squash turns silky-tender and apricots plump; spoon over warm pearl barley and top with chopped cilantro.
tips: Kitchen shears halve dried apricots cleanly in seconds without sticking to a chef's knife.
Top with toasted sliced almonds if you enjoy a gentle festive finish.

recipes.title: Baked Mediterranean Chicken with Butternut Squash, Artichokes & Savory
recipes.summary: One-dish baked supper roasting pre-cubed squash until tender alongside juicy chicken tenders, quartered artichoke hearts, summer savory, rosemary, olive oil, and lemon.
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F and toss pre-cubed squash with half the olive oil, summer savory, rosemary, and black pepper in a baking dish; cover with foil and bake 12 minutes.
Uncover, nestle chicken tenders and halved artichoke hearts among the tender squash, and drizzle with remaining olive oil and fresh lemon juice.
Bake uncovered 14 minutes more until chicken is juicy and cooked through and squash is golden and fork-soft.
tips: Covering the dish briefly traps gentle steam so squash turns melt-in-the-mouth soft.
Everything roasts in one ceramic dish for effortless cleanup.

recipes.title: Velvety Autumn-Spiced Roasted Butternut, Banana & Walnut Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Thick pumpkin-pie-style smoothie blending chilled cooked butternut squash, frozen banana, soft Medjool dates, oat milk, cinnamon, ginger, clove, almond butter, and walnut oil.
steps: Pour chilled oat milk into the blender and add cooked chilled butternut squash, frozen banana, pitted dates, and smooth almond butter.
Add cinnamon, freshly grated ginger, a pinch of clove, and roasted walnut oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until ultra-velvety, frosty, and warmly autumn-spiced.
tips: Roasted or steamed butternut squash blends far smoother than fibrous pumpkin and has natural caramel sweetness.
Tuck extra cooked dinner squash into 3/4-cup freezer bags for effortless 1-minute smoothies.

recipes.title: Golden Butternut Squash, Navel Orange & Turmeric Cashew Smoothie
recipes.summary: Radiant golden-orange blend uniting soft cooked butternut squash, peeled navel orange, banana, smooth cashew butter, chilled oat milk, turmeric, fresh ginger, and black pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch finely cracked black pepper

steps: Combine chilled oat milk, peeled navel orange segments, chilled cooked squash, and frozen banana in the blender.
Add smooth cashew butter, turmeric, freshly grated ginger, and a tiny pinch of cracked black pepper.
Blend on high 60 seconds until sunshine-bright and completely cloud-smooth.
tips: Cashew butter brings velvety richness while supporting absorption of fat-soluble beta-carotene and curcumin.
Fresh sweet orange balances the silky squash with lively citrus sparkle.

recipes.title: Silky Butternut Squash, Dark Chocolate & Medjool Date Almond Shake
recipes.summary: Rich fudge-smooth shake hiding silky cooked butternut squash beneath dark chocolate, soft Medjool dates, frozen banana, almond butter, almond milk, cinnamon, and flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: finely grated 70% dark chocolate or unsweetened cocoa

steps: Pour chilled almond milk into the blender with cooked chilled squash, pitted Medjool dates, and frozen banana.
Add dark chocolate, smooth almond butter, cinnamon, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until thick, frosty, and luxuriously chocolaty.
tips: Cooked butternut squash creates milkshake-thick body without tasting savory at all under dark chocolate.
A sneaky, effortless way to fold extra orange vegetables into a delicious afternoon treat.

recipes.title: Spiced Butternut Squash, Sweet Apple & Ginger Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Orchard-harvest smoothie blending soft cooked butternut squash, peeled sweet apple, frozen banana, chilled oat milk, cinnamon, ginger, clove, and roasted walnut oil.
steps: Combine chilled oat milk, cooked squash, peeled apple quarters, and frozen banana in the blender.
Add cinnamon, grated ginger, ground clove, and roasted walnut oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until velvety, crisp-sweet, and completely skin-free.
tips: Peeling the apple first keeps every sip smooth with zero thin peel flecks.
Roasted walnut oil adds toasted autumn warmth.

recipes.title: Lush Butternut Squash, Sweet Apricot & Chia Velvet Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep amber stone-fruit smoothie blending cooked chilled butternut squash, ripe or soaked apricots, frozen banana, oat milk, chia seeds, warm ginger, cinnamon, and flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: ripe fresh apricots (or 5 warm-soaked dried apricots)

steps: Add chilled oat milk, cooked squash, pitted apricots, and frozen banana to the blender.
Sprinkle in chia seeds, grated ginger, cinnamon, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until satin-smooth and glowing golden-amber.
tips: Apricot and squash make a remarkably silky fruit-vegetable pairing rich in gentle fiber.
Soak dried unsulfured apricots in hot water 10 minutes before blending when fresh fruit is out of season.

recipes.title: Vibrant Butternut Squash, Wild Blueberry & Orange Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky berry-harvest blend marrying cooked butternut squash with frozen wild blueberries, fresh orange juice, oat milk, ripe banana, cinnamon, chia seeds, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Pour chilled oat milk and fresh orange juice into the blender with cooked squash, frozen wild blueberries, and banana.
Add cinnamon, chia seeds, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until lush indigo-smooth and frosty.
tips: Frozen wild blueberries lend deep color and intense berry sweetness while cooked squash adds velvety thickness.
Zero peeling or cutting—simply scoop, blend, and pour.

recipes.title: Autumn-Spiced Butternut, Chilled Coffee & Almond Latte Shake
recipes.summary: Homemade spice-latte smoothie blending velvety cooked butternut squash, chilled brewed coffee, oat milk, pitted Medjool dates, smooth almond butter, cinnamon, ginger, and clove.
steps: Pour chilled brewed coffee and oat milk into the blender with cooked chilled squash, pitted dates, and smooth almond butter.
Add cinnamon, ground ginger, a pinch of clove, and 4 ice cubes if desired.
Blend on high 60 seconds until café-frothy and caramel-smooth.
tips: Real roasted squash and Medjool dates replace sugary coffee-shop syrups with whole-food comfort.
Swap in chilled decaf coffee for a cozy afternoon treat.

recipes.title: Coral Butternut Squash, Tart Cherry & Fresh Ginger Recovery Smoothie
recipes.summary: Soothing sunset-coral smoothie combining silky cooked butternut squash, frozen pitted cherries, ripe banana, chilled oat milk, grated ginger, cinnamon, chia, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Combine chilled oat milk, cooked squash, frozen pitted cherries, and ripe banana in the blender.
Add freshly grated ginger, cinnamon, chia seeds, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until bright coral-ruby and completely silky.
tips: Frozen pre-pitted cherries make prep effortless and chill the blend naturally.
Gentle anti-inflammatory smoothie ideal after stretching or a morning walk.

recipes.title: Cooling Butternut Squash, Cantaloupe & Spearmint Coconut Smoothie
recipes.summary: Light golden-melon smoothie blending chilled cooked butternut squash, ripe diced cantaloupe, coconut water, fresh spearmint leaves, grated ginger, frozen banana, and chia seeds.
steps: Pour chilled coconut water into the blender with cantaloupe cubes, chilled cooked squash, and frozen banana.
Toss in fresh spearmint leaves, grated ginger, and chia seeds.
Blend on high 50 seconds until frosty, silky, and sun-bright.
tips: Cantaloupe and cooked squash share gentle golden sweetness while coconut water keeps the blend light and hydrating.
Buy pre-cubed melon to skip slicing slippery rinds.

recipes.title: Creamy Butternut Squash, Raspberry, Blackberry & Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety rose-berry smoothie combining soft cooked butternut squash, raspberries, blackberries, ripe banana, chilled oat milk, fragrant lemon balm leaves, chia, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Combine chilled oat milk, cooked squash, raspberries, blackberries, and banana in the blender.
Add fresh lemon balm leaves, chia seeds, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 60 seconds until lush ruby-cream; strain briefly if you prefer zero berry seeds.
tips: Straining through a sieve takes seconds and gives an ultra-smooth drink for anyone sensitive to berry seeds.
Mild sweet squash mellows bright tart berries effortlessly.

recipes.title: Sweet Golden Butternut Squash, Carrot, Apple & Ginger Pressed Juice
recipes.summary: Bright golden harvest press juicing raw pre-cubed butternut squash with sweet carrots, crisp apple, peeled navel orange, fresh ginger root, turmeric, and cracked black pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch finely cracked black pepper

steps: Feed raw pre-cubed butternut squash, carrots, apple quarters, peeled orange, and fresh ginger through a juicer into a chilled pitcher.
Whisk turmeric and a tiny pinch of finely cracked black pepper directly into the bright amber-gold juice.
Pour into chilled glasses and enjoy right away.
tips: Raw pre-cubed butternut squash juices cleanly just like crisp melon or carrot, yielding naturally sweet golden nectar with zero rind peeling.
No juicer? Blend 1/2 cup softly steamed squash with 1 cup fresh carrot juice, 1/2 cup apple juice, orange juice, and grated ginger, then strain smoothly.

recipes.title: Bright Butternut Squash, Navel Orange, Turmeric & Cinnamon Press
recipes.summary: Luminous citrus sunrise tonic combining raw pressed butternut squash and carrot juices with sweet navel orange, fresh ginger, golden turmeric, cinnamon, and black pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch finely cracked black pepper

steps: Juice raw pre-cubed squash, peeled navel oranges, carrot, and fresh ginger into a pitcher.
Whisk in golden turmeric, a gentle dusting of cinnamon, and a tiny pinch of finely cracked black pepper.
Serve immediately while frothy and bright.
tips: Sweet orange oils lift mellow raw squash into a sunny morning glass.
Rinse juicer parts right after pouring so fine squash pulp washes cleanly away.

recipes.title: Crisp Butternut Squash, Sweet Apple, Celery Stalk & Spearmint Press
recipes.summary: Refreshing pale-gold garden juice pressing raw pre-cubed squash, sweet apple, hydrating celery stalks, fresh spearmint leaves, ginger, and a bright splash of lemon.
steps: Run raw pre-cubed squash, cored apple quarters, celery stalks, fresh spearmint leaves, and ginger through a juicer.
Stir in fresh lemon juice immediately to brighten the light golden hue.
Pour over ice and sip crisp and cold.
tips: Using bagged pre-cubed squash lets you press fresh vegetable juice with minimal hand work.
Celery and spearmint keep this press remarkably clean and refreshing.

recipes.title: Spiced Autumn Butternut Squash, Pressed Apple, Clove & Cinnamon Cooler
recipes.summary: Fragrant autumn cooler steeping cinnamon, whole cloves, and ginger in water, then blending smoothly with softly cooked squash, pressed apple juice, and orange, strained crystal-clean.
steps: Simmer cinnamon stick, whole cloves, and sliced ginger in 1 cup water 6 minutes, remove spices, and chill.
Blend chilled spice infusion with softly cooked squash, cloudy apple juice, and orange juice 30 seconds.
Pass cleanly through a fine-mesh strainer and pour over ice (or serve gently warmed).
tips: No juicer needed—a simple blender and sieve make a silky golden spiced orchard cooler in minutes.
Lovely served chilled in September or warmed in mugs through winter.

recipes.title: Ruby-Gold Butternut Squash, Beetroot, Carrot & Orange Vitality Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-colored wellness press blending fresh carrot and orange juices with softly cooked squash, pre-cooked beetroot, fresh ginger, turmeric, and black pepper, strained silky.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch finely cracked black pepper

steps: Blend fresh carrot juice, orange juice, softly cooked squash, pre-cooked beetroot, grated ginger, turmeric, and cracked black pepper 35 seconds.
Press smoothly through a fine-mesh strainer into a chilled pitcher.
Serve immediately over ice.
tips: Combines three golden-ruby root and winter vegetables with zero peeling or juicer scrubbing.
Wash blender right after pouring to prevent ruby stains.

recipes.title: Cooling Butternut Squash, Cantaloupe, Cucumber & Shiso Tonic
recipes.summary: Refreshing melon-gold spa tonic blending raw or tender squash with juicy cantaloupe, peeled cucumber, fresh green shiso leaves, ginger, lime, and chilled water, strained clear.
steps: Blend chilled cooked squash, diced cantaloupe, peeled cucumber, fresh shiso leaves, grated ginger, lime juice, and chilled water 35 seconds.
Strain smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing gently with a spoon.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Cantaloupe and cucumber lighten mellow squash into a crisp, spa-like hydrating glass.
Save the damp melon-squash pulp to stir into tomorrow's morning oats.

recipes.title: Calming Golden Butternut, Apricot, Chamomile & Lemon Balm Cooler
recipes.summary: Soothing amber afternoon cooler uniting chilled chamomile-lemon balm tea with softly cooked squash, pure apricot nectar, orange juice, and fresh ginger, strained velvet-clear.
steps: Steep chamomile, lemon balm leaves, and grated ginger in 1 cup hot water 6 minutes, strain out herbs, and chill.
Blend chilled herbal tea with softly cooked squash, pure apricot nectar, and orange juice 30 seconds.
Pass cleanly through a fine-mesh strainer into chilled glasses.
tips: Gentle caffeine-free hydration with warm orchard sweetness for peaceful afternoons.
Using a chamomile tea bag makes steeping and cleanup effortless.

recipes.title: Tangy Harvest Butternut, Cranberry, Red Grape & Anise Seed Tonic
recipes.summary: Festive jewel-toned cooler blending chilled anise-cinnamon infusion with softly cooked squash, unsweetened cranberry juice, sweet red grape juice, orange, and ginger.
steps: Steep crushed anise seed, cinnamon stick, and grated ginger in 1 cup hot water 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend chilled spice infusion with softly cooked squash, cranberry juice, red grape juice, and orange juice 30 seconds.
Strain smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve into a pitcher and serve over ice.
tips: Red grape and sweet squash balance brisk cranberry smoothly without added sugar.
Makes a striking alcohol-free holiday pitcher ready in 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Antioxidant Butternut Squash, Blueberry, Raspberry & Orange Elixir
recipes.summary: Deep berry-amber press blending softly cooked squash, fresh blueberries, raspberries, sweet orange juice, pressed apple juice, and fresh ginger, strained crisp and seed-free.
steps: Blend softly cooked squash, fresh blueberries, fresh raspberries, orange juice, pressed apple juice, and grated ginger 35 seconds.
Strain smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing gently with a spoon to remove all berry seeds.
Pour into two chilled glasses and sip right away.
tips: Straining yields a silky jewel-bright drink that slips down effortlessly.
Zero juicer required—just a blender and simple strainer.

recipes.title: Warming Golden Butternut, Carrot, Ginger & Faint Cayenne Tonic
recipes.summary: Invigorating amber wellness tonic combining raw pressed butternut squash and carrot juices with bright orange, zingy fresh ginger, turmeric, cracked black pepper, and faint cayenne.
steps: Juice raw pre-cubed squash, scrubbed carrots, peeled orange, and fresh ginger into a small pitcher.
Whisk in ground turmeric, finely cracked black pepper, and just a faint pinch of cayenne pepper.
Pour into small chilled tonic glasses and sip fresh.
tips: Keep cayenne to a whisper so the tonic warms gently without irritating sensitive throats.
No juicer? Blend 1/2 cup cooked chilled squash with 1 cup store-bought fresh carrot juice, 1/2 cup orange juice, and spices, then strain smoothly.
